title: Lieutenant Frederick Schwatka
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: Portrait of Frederick Schwatka, who led the 1878-80 sledge search of King William Island - the longest sledge journey then made, and the one that recovered Irving's grave and the last of the Franklin relics.

title: Camp Daly in summer
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The expedition's base at Camp Daly on the west shore of Hudson Bay, in the open season.

title: Esquimaux going to the hunting-ground
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: Inuit setting out to hunt from Camp Daly, on whom the whole expedition depended for food.

title: A cairn
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: One of the stone cairns of the region, of the kind the search parties opened in the hope of a record.

title: Cairn marking a deposit of provisions
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: A cairn raised over a cached depot - the method by which a sledge party fed itself on the return.

title: The ships in winter quarters
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: Whaling ships housed over for the winter on the west coast of Hudson Bay, where Schwatka's party wintered before starting north.

title: Esquimau playing the ki-lowty
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: An Inuk beating the qilaut, the flat wind drum, at Camp Daly.

title: Camp Daly in winter
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The base in the dark season, with snow houses and sledges.

title: Down-hill with the sledges
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The sledges running downhill on the march north.

title: Hunting musk-oxen
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: Muskoxen brought to bay by the dogs - the fresh meat that made the long sledge journey possible.

title: The great bend in the Hayes River
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The bend of the Hayes River on the route north.

title: The sources of the Hayes River
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The headwaters of the Hayes River.

title: Meeting with the Ookjooliks
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The party's meeting with the Ukjulingmiut, whose people had seen a ship of Franklin's beset and had been aboard her. Their testimony is the core of what is known about the Erebus's last months.

title: The Netchillik ambassadress
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: A Netsilingmiut woman who came to the camp as spokeswoman for her people - one of the few plates in the Franklin literature in which an Inuit woman is the named subject of a formal encounter.

title: The council with the Netchilliks
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The council at which the Netsilingmiut told Schwatka's party what they knew of the white men who had died on King William's Land.

title: Snow-huts on Cape Herschel
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The search party's snow houses at Cape Herschel on the south-west coast of King William Island, close to where Franklin's retreating crews passed.

title: Crossing Erebus Bay
creator: Heinrich Klutschak and others, engraved for Scribner's
description: The party crossing Erebus Bay on the west coast of King William Island, where the boat and skeletons had been found in 1859.

description: A weathered clay-stone formation noted on the march.
